exposure: Induction of labor (IOL) at 39 weeks gestation
cohort: The study cohort consisted of nulliparous women reaching 39 weeks of gestation.
finding: Routine induction of labor at 39 weeks and expectant management have similar population-wide Pelvic Organ Prolapse risk (15.9% and 15.7% respectively).
mod_finding: While routine induction of labor at 39 weeks results in a meaningfully higher vaginal delivery rate, there was no increase in POP, possibly due to the protective effect of lower birthweight.
birth_weight: Slightly lighter birthweight infants with IOL; differential infant weights in each strategy were accounted for.
